evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: This is a variation of the vulnerability reported in CVE-2021-28164/GHSA-v7ff-8wcx-gmc5.
evidence.decode_normalize_evolution: Jetty 9.4.37 made URI parsing RFC-compliant (normalize-before-decode), leaving URIs open to later normalization; CVE-2021-28164 (fixed 9.4.39) blocked the plain %2e dot-segment reaching WEB-INF but kept %u002e/encoded-null decoding; CVE-2021-34429 (fixed 9.4.43) reversed the order so URIs are first decoded then normalized, added rejection of ambiguous segments (encoded dot/separator/empty/null) as 400, and required normalized paths in ContextHandler.getResource.

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with official Eclipse Jetty images (9.4.38/9.4.39/9.4.43-jre8, linux/amd64 under emulation). Recipe-based: images pulled at up-time; ROOT webapp + canary WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt materialised by compose entrypoint from ${PCB_FLAG}. Gate run 2026-07-14 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate`; see repro.log. Original %2e dot-segment reads canary on 9.4.38 (HTTP 200), blocked on 9.4.39 (HTTP 404). Residual %u002e reads canary on 9.4.39 (HTTP 200), closed on 9.4.43 (HTTP 404); encoded-null /.%00 also reads on 9.4.39 (200) and is rejected on 9.4.43 (HTTP 400). Plain GET /WEB-INF/pcb-secret.txt = 404 on all three versions, so the disclosure is genuinely the encoding bypass of the authorization-before-canonicalization gate.

audit.evidence: python3 oracle.py --run-gate on real Docker with official Eclipse Jetty images (9.4.38/9.4.39/9.4.43-jre8): plain WEB-INF denied all (404); original %2e reaches@v0 (200), blocked@v1 (404); residual %u002e reaches@v1 (200), blocked@v2 (404); residual .%00 reaches@v1 (200), blocked@v2 (400). passed=true, flag=PCBFLAG_f41b067743ac2d243ddc79700063cc5a. Boots the real published Jetty server -> real-app.
